quarterly_data.signal: Backlog as of June 30, 2026 was $14.06 billion (Mechanical 71.5% / Electrical 28.5%), up 12.9% from $12.45 billion at March 31, 2026. Same-store sequential growth of $1.39 billion (11.2%) came primarily from technology-sector bookings at its Texas electrical operation ($1.00 billion) and its Texas modular operation ($510.2 million), partially offset by completed technology-sector work at a North Carolina operation ($118.5 million); the Hunt acquisition added $217.4 million. The company expects to recognize approximately 65-75% of its $14.06 billion of remaining performance obligations over the next 12 months.
